searchText: Can we expect the information on https://launchpad.ethereum.org/en/withdrawals will be updated and tooling for partial withdrawals will be accessible from that page as soon as Pectra launches? Also, will an additional main header page be added for 'Consolidate'? Something I think might be worth considering would be to have a 'Validator Tools' heading with submenu items for Deposit, Top Up, Withdraw, and Consolidate.
